Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Industrial Modern Wood and Metal Coffee Table, 31.5"W, Walnut
Colors: Walnut
Materials: metal
You'll enjoy resting your glass or remote control on this eclectic, industrial-style coffee table as you kick back and relax. Its compact size is ideal for a smaller space in front of a sofa, and perfect for serving snacks at your next party. 31.5"W x15"D x 23.2"H Solid hardwood top with walnut finish; metal legs with black matte finish Wood and metal are combined for a chic industrial look Compact size is ideal for a smaller room in front of a sofa Easy assembly in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
